listening.title: Closing the month with two unreconciled items

lines.speaker: Nam (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Linh, how is the reconciliation statement for August going?

lines.speaker: Linh (Accountant)
lines.text: Almost done. But I still have two unreconciled items in the bank account.

lines.speaker: Nam (Finance Manager)
lines.text: How big are they? Can we still close the month today?

lines.speaker: Linh (Accountant)
lines.text: One is small, about twelve thousand dong. It is only a rounding difference.

lines.speaker: Nam (Finance Manager)
lines.text: That is fine. And what about the other one?

lines.speaker: Linh (Accountant)
lines.text: A payment of fifty million dong appears twice in the system export.

lines.speaker: Nam (Finance Manager)
lines.text: That looks like a double posting. Can you trace it back to the invoice?

lines.speaker: Linh (Accountant)
lines.text: Yes. I will check the line item in the ledger and call the bank.

lines.speaker: Nam (Finance Manager)
lines.text: If the mistake is ours, please make a reversal entry, not a manual adjustment.

lines.speaker: Linh (Accountant)
lines.text: Understood. Then we can match the figures with the bank statement exactly.

lines.speaker: Nam (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Great. Send me the final report before four o'clock, please.

questions.q: What is the small difference of twelve thousand dong?
What is wrong with the fifty million dong payment?
